question: For the top five team markets with the highest number of distinct players who scored at least 15 points during the second period of games between 2010 and 2018, provide details of each game they played in NCAA basketball historical tournament matches during the same period, as specified in the data model document.
sql:
WITH top_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_market, player_id
  FROM (
    SELECT team_market, player_id, SUM(points_scored) as period2_points
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
    WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
      AND period = 2
      AND points_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY team_market, player_id
    HAVING SUM(points_scored) >= 15
  )
  WHERE team_market IN (
    SELECT team_market FROM (
      SELECT team_market, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) as cnt
      FROM (
        SELECT team_market, player_id, SUM(points_scored) as period2_points
        FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
        WHERE season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
          AND period = 2
          AND points_scored IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY team_market, player_id
        HAVING SUM(points_scored) >= 15
      )
      GROUP BY team_market
      ORDER BY cnt DESC
      LIMIT 5
    )
  )
)
SELECT DISTINCT tp.team_market as top_market, tp.player_id, pgs.game_id, pgs.season, pgs.scheduled_date, pgs.tournament_type, pgs.tournament_round, pgs.team_market as game_team_market, pgs.team_name, pgs.points
FROM top_players tp
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_players_games_sr` pgs
  ON tp.player_id = pgs.player_id
  AND pgs.tournament = 'NCAA'
  AND pgs.season BETWEEN 2010 AND 2018
ORDER BY tp.team_market, tp.player_id, pgs.season, pgs.game_id
